text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! It's finally time for the Shinzan
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I heard there'll be a slew of
speedy runners
since it's a graded race,
so winnin' probably won't
be so easy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All that said... I ain't gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep dashin' all the way to becoming

Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You know it! I'm right there with ya on
that
one. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me! I'll blow everybody away
with my
hurricane speed!
